import QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalPrepare
open QleisliKernel SourceTypes Semantics.SourceNatural Semantics.SourceAffine

def run {α : Type} (action : Finite.WorkM α) := (action.run 10000000).1

def keys (source : String) : Option (List (String × String)) :=
  (run (NaturalCatalog.prepare #[("main",source)])).toOption.map fun entries =>
    entries.map (fun original => (original.key.moduleName,original.key.declarationName))

example : keys "static fn later[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {first[n]()} static fn first[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n}" =
  some [("main","first"),("main","later")] := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn f[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {g[n]()} static fn g[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {f[n]()}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn unused() -> Nat {unknown()} static fn main() -> Nat {0}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn unused() -> Nat {missing+1}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "fn runtime() -> Bit {0} static fn unused() -> Nat {runtime()}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn f[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n} static fn g() -> Nat {f()}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn f[const f:Nat]() -> Nat {f[1]()}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : keys "static fn f() -> Nat {1} static fn f() -> Nat {2}" = none := by decide +kernel
example : !(run (NaturalCatalog.prepare #[
  ("defs","pub static fn actual[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n}"),
  ("hidden","use defs::actual;"),
  ("main","static fn unused() -> Nat {hidden::actual[1]()}" )])).isOk := by decide +kernel
example : (run (NaturalCatalog.prepare #[
  ("defs","pub static fn actual[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n}"),
  ("exports","pub use defs::actual;"),
  ("main","use exports::actual; static fn unused() -> Nat {actual[1]()}" )])).isOk := by decide +kernel

def noCalls : Calls := fun _ _ => none

def leaf (source : String) : Except Finite.Error (List (Int × List Int)) := do
  let entries ← run (NaturalCatalog.prepare #[("main",source)])
  entries.mapM fun original => do
    let checked ← run (NaturalPrepare.check original noCalls
      {read := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ _ => throw .request})
    return (checked.body.form.constant,checked.body.form.coefficients)

-- Generic original bodies are checked independently of a later chosen argument.
example : (leaf "static fn previous[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n >= 1 {n-1}").toOption =
  some [(-1,[1])] := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn diff[const z:Nat,const a:Nat]() -> Nat requires z >= a {z-a}").toOption =
  some [(0,[-1,1])] := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn sum[const z:Nat,const a:Nat]() -> Nat {z+a}").toOption =
  some [(0,[1,1])] := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn previous[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n-1} struct R {bits:Bits<previous[1]()>}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn square[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n*n} struct R {bits:Bits<square[1]()>}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn square[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n == 1 {n*n}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn unused[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {n-1} static fn valid() -> Nat {1}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn cancel[const n:Nat]() -> Nat {(n-n)*n}").toOption =
  some [(0,[0])] := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn previous[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n >= 1,n-1 <= 3 {n-1}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn previous[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n-1 <= 3,n >= 1 {n-1}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn impossible[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n >= 2,n <= 1 {n}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn relaxation[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires 2*n == 1 {n}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : !(leaf "static fn wrong[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n != 0 {n-2}").isOk := by decide +kernel
example : (leaf "static fn good[const n:Nat]() -> Nat requires n != 0 {n-1}").isOk := by decide +kernel

def substitute (constant : Int) (coefficients : List Int) (replacements : List Form) (variables : Nat) :=
  (run (NaturalSubstitute.substitute variables ⟨constant,coefficients⟩ replacements)).toOption.map fun result =>
    (result.form.constant,result.form.coefficients)
example : substitute 7 [3,-2] [⟨1,[2]⟩,⟨4,[1]⟩] 1 = some (2,[4]) := by decide +kernel
-- Simultaneous replacements, even when a caller spelling matches a callee one.
example : substitute 0 [1,1] [⟨1,[0,1]⟩,⟨8,[0,0]⟩] 2 = some (9,[0,1]) := by decide +kernel
example : substitute 0 [2] [⟨170141183460469231731687303715884105727,[]⟩] 0 = none := by decide +kernel
example : substitute 0 [0] [⟨0,List.replicate 33 0⟩] 1 = none := by decide +kernel
example : substitute 0 [1,1] [⟨1,[]⟩] 0 = none := by decide +kernel

#print axioms NaturalPrepare.check
#print axioms NaturalNormalize.Result.value
#print axioms NaturalSubstitute.substitute
